description: Free: for a finished wake word (order_id from wake_word_status), returns Ania’s page that runs the model live with the person’s microphone (meter + flash when it wakes), so they hear how well it works before download_wake_word.

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.

order_id.description: Wake-word order id from create_wake_word or wake_word_status.
